headline: All 3/3 amine hardeners that report both an amine value and an AHEW fall inside the amine-value-derived stoichiometric admissibility band (28052.8/AV <= AHEW <= 56105.6/AV), with implied active-H-per-basic-N in [1,2] for 3/3; 3 AHEW constants lack an amine value and remain honestly single-source; gross AHEW corruption is flagged out-of-band (fail-closed).
hypothesis: Every hardener AHEW that also has a reported amine value must satisfy the stoichiometric band M_KOH/(2*AV) <= AHEW <= M_KOH/AV; gross AHEW corruption falls outside the band (fail-closed).
non_circularity: Amine value is titrated (ASTM D2073/D2074) independently of the AHEW epoxy-stoichiometry determination; the band ties the two independently-measured quantities via amine chemistry, so intra-TDS mutual consistency is a genuine cross-quantity second signal, not a self-referential re-read.
purpose: Independent physical second-signal for the load-bearing amine-hardener AHEW constant family via the amine-value<->AHEW stoichiometric admissibility band; closes part of the open honest-negative left by constant-crosscheck-v1.
